name: Feature request
about: Propose a bounded, owner-authorized capability or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## User need

What owner-authorized outcome should become possible?

## Proposed scope

What is the smallest useful read, export, recovery, or action boundary?

## Privacy and authorization

- What private data would be read, persisted, logged, or disclosed?
- Who authorizes it, and how is that authorization scoped?
- What must remain unavailable to an AI or downstream service?

## Failure behavior

What ambiguity, version drift, unsafe path, stale source, or partial coverage
should make the feature stop?

## Alternatives

Could an existing bounded query, policy, snapshot, or export solve the need?

<!-- Never attach real user data, credentials, application binaries, or dumps. -->
